title: Northeastern Pomo language - Wikipedia
text: Northeastern Pomo, also known as Salt Pomo, is a Pomoan language of Northern California. There are no living fluent speakers. It was spoken along Stony Creek, a tributary of the Sacramento River. Northeastern was one of seven mutually unintelligible Pomoan languages spoken in Northern California.

title: Northeastern Pomo language — Grokipedia
text: Northeastern Pomo, also known as Salt Pomo, is an extinct Indigenous language of California that belongs to the Pomoan language family, one of seven mutually unintelligible Pomoan languages hypothesized to form a branch of the broader Hokan stock. [1]
